en: Vintage black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing gentle fields, a line of young trees along a road or railway, several villas on a hillside, and a larger, turreted building to the right. A central building bears the sign "Pension Kaiserhof." Printed caption text in red at the bottom identifies the place as Bärenfels in the Saxon Ore Mountains. A red handwritten number "2246" appears at the top right.
